extracted.name: Jerk dipping sauce
extracted.description: Great recipe for Jerk dipping sauce.
ingredient_lines: 2 tbsp sweet dark soy sauce, or regular
Half bunch of cilantro and stems
4 oz can of pineapple in real juice or 1/2 cup pineapple juice
instruction_lines: Combine all Ingredients and process until smooth. Add oil yo a pan and heat. Add the mixture and simmer for about 7 minutes. Let cool and store or serve.
Hot sauce glaze Add it to a pot and simmer as usual but add ketchup and honey to taste and then add to a vitamin until smooth
